what_this_changes.what_was_asked: Whether a2-path's unedited feed-forwards 29 to 34 write the plus from what its early edit passes on, and whether the plus is the changed weights' or the reworded history's.
what_this_changes.what_the_traces_say: Both parts are answered. The late six, and layers 9 to 28, write the plus without having been changed (prediction 2). But on the text a2-path has written by then, the original's own weights favour the plus too, at 5 of 6 declared rows and 12 of 13 with the wider finder. By the declaration's own words for this outcome, the flip is carried by the reworded history, and a count of plus signs on own answers is not evidence that the weights changed the decision at the sign: the token is shown, on this model, not to define the divergence. The weights' own part at the row is real and one-sided, 1 to 7 logits toward the plus on the same text, and it too arrives through unchanged late merges.
what_this_changes.where_the_path_forks: Read after the predictions: the text leaves the original's at the answer's fourth token in 19 of 30, a token the original held by a quarter of a logit at the median and a2-path's weights moved by a third of a logit. The record of the transplanted openings (runs/opening-transplants-replay-original/result.json) had already shown the original writing the plus by itself in 9 of 13 wrong answers once one to four near-tie opening tokens were supplied. The two agree: on this capability the original writes the plus or the minus by the wording it has taken, and a2-path changes which wording is taken.
what_this_changes.for_the_four_constructions: The chain and the three beside it ask feed-forward 29 to 34 for the plus at the original's own sign rows, on the original's own wording: the failing path itself, which a2-path leaves unrepaired and walks around. Their reading therefore rests on the same-text control and the fixed-input site reading, already in read-candidate.sh (control-capture, direct with its control, site-matrix), and on the first differing token with its margin in both models (record), and not on a count of own-answer signs. A candidate whose own answers add the descent is read first for whether its text leaves the original's at a near tie before the row.
what_this_changes.not_decided_here: Whether a correction that makes the model take the wording on which it already computes correctly is a repair of the capability is a question of the method and the hypothesis: Astra's assessment, and Marcos's where it changes a step. What a construction aimed at the fork would ask is Astra's to specify.
